title: S$^3$F-Net: A Multi-Modal Approach to Medical Image Classification via Spatial-Spectral Summarizer Fusion Network
abstract: arXiv:2509.23442v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks have become a cornerstone of medical image analysis due to their proficiency in learning hierarchical spatial features. However, this focus on a single domain is inefficient at capturing global, holistic patterns and fails to explicitly model an image's frequency-domain characteristics. To address these challenges, we propose the Spatial-Spectral Summarizer Fusion Network (S$^3$F-Net), a dual-branch framework that learns from both spatial and spectral representations simultaneously. The S$^3$F-Net performs a fusion of a deep spatial CNN with our proposed shallow spectral encoder, SpectraNet. SpectraNet features the proposed SpectralFilter layer, which leverages the Convolution Theorem by applying a bank of learnable filters directly to an image's full Fourier spectrum via a computation-efficient element-wise multiplication. translated_title: S³F-Net：一种通过空间-频谱摘要融合网络实现医学图像分类的多模态方法
translated_abstract: 卷积神经网络因其在学习层次化空间特征方面的出色能力，已成为医学图像分析的基石。然而，这种对单一域的关注在捕获全局、整体模式方面效率低下，且未能显式建模图像的频域特性。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了空间-频谱摘要融合网络（S³F-Net），这是一个同时从空间和频谱表示中学习的双分支框架。S³F-Net 将深度空间 CNN 与我们提出的浅层频谱编码器 SpectraNet 进行融合。SpectraNet 的特色在于所提出的 SpectralFilter 层，该层利用卷积定理，通过计算高效的逐元素乘法直接对图像的完整傅里叶频谱应用一组可学习的滤波器。这使得 SpectralFilter 层能够获得全局感受野……
tldr: 提出了双分支网络S³F-Net，将深度空间CNN与浅层频谱编码器SpectraNet相融合，其中SpectralFilter层基于卷积定理通过逐元素乘法直接在完整傅里叶频谱上应用可学习滤波器以获得全局感受野，从而同时利用空间与频域表示提升医学图像分类性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes S³F-Net, a dual-branch network that fuses a deep spatial CNN with a shallow spectral encoder SpectraNet, whose SpectralFilter layer applies learnable filter banks directly on the full Fourier spectrum via efficient element-wise multiplication to achieve a global receptive field, thereby leveraging both spatial and frequency-domain representations for improved medical image classification.
